name: @droneey/constitution
description: The engineering constitution of droneey: blocks of rules a project declares in constitution.yaml.

scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.build: bun build --target=bun --packages=external ./tools/mutation-check/src/main.ts --outdir tools/mutation-check/dist && mkdir -p tools/python-check/dist tools/mutmut-check/dist && python3 -m zipapp tools/python-check/src -m python_check.main:main -o tools/python-check/dist/python-check.pyz && python3 -m zipapp tools/mutmut-check/src -m mutmut_check.main:main -o tools/mutmut-check/dist/mutmut-check.pyz
scripts.secrets:check: betterleaks git . --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && betterleaks git . --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner
scripts.python:lint:check: uv run --locked ruff check tools && uv run --locked complexipy tools/python-check tools/mutmut-check && uv run --locked python-check tools/python-check/src tools/python-check/tests tools/mutmut-check/src tools/mutmut-check/tests
scripts.python:unused:check: for package in tools/python-check tools/mutmut-check; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../.. deptry src || exit 1; done && for package in tools/python-check tools/mutmut-check; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../.. vulture || exit 1; done
scripts.python:test: for package in tools/python-check tools/mutmut-check; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../.. pytest --cov || exit 1; done
scripts.python:mutation:check: for package in tools/python-check tools/mutmut-check; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../.. mutmut-check || exit 1; done
scripts.python:mutation:all: for package in tools/python-check tools/mutmut-check; do uv run --locked --directory "$package" --project ../.. mutmut-check all || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run lint:check && bun run packages:check && bun run type:check && bun run python:format:check && bun run python:lint:check && bun run python:type:check && bun run architecture:check && bun run test && bun run mutation:check && bun run python:test && bun run python:mutation:check && bun run blocks:check && bun run secrets:check && bun run names:check && bun run unused:check && bun run python:unused:check && bun run audit:check
